definition_quote.value: "Emergency medical technician" (EMT) shall mean a person trained, and currently certified by the State Fire Prevention Commission, in emergency medical care procedures through a course which meets the objectives of the national scope of practice.
definition_quote.quote: "Emergency medical technician" (EMT) shall mean a person trained, and currently certified by the State Fire Prevention Commission, in emergency medical care procedures through a course which meets the objectives of the national scope of practice.

methods_authorized.quote: "Basic life support" (BLS) shall mean the level of capability which provides prehospital, noninvasive emergency patient care designed to optimize the patient's chances of surviving an emergency situation.

certification_levels.quote: "Ambulance attendant" shall mean a person trained in emergency medical care procedures and currently certified by the Delaware State Fire Prevention Commission... Such course shall be classified as basic life support and shall be the minimum acceptable level of training for certified emergency medical personnel.

national_registry_exam_required.quote: Currently requires the use of the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) examination as a condition of issuing initial licenses at the EMT and paramedic levels.

advanced_practice_subspecialties.quote: "Community paramedicine" means a form of mobile-integrated healthcare that is a provider-led, patient-centered delivery care model using appropriately-trained paramedics or other emergency medical services providers in an expanded role to render care

community_paramedicine_authorized.quote: An organization licensed as or actively seeking licensure as an emergency medical services provider agency may apply to the Office to establish a mobile-integrated healthcare or community paramedicine program.
community_paramedicine_authorized.citation: § 9817. Mobile-integrated healthcare and community paramedicine programs

medical_director_required.quote: There shall be 5 part time EMS Medical Directors: 1 State EMS Medical Director, 3 county EMS medical directors and 1 Basic Life Support EMS Director.

medical_director_board_certification_req.quote: Each EMS medical director shall be employed by the State, by contract or otherwise, and shall be a board certified emergency physician actually involved in the practice of emergency medicine.

standing_orders_authorized.quote: If direct voice communication between a physician and a paramedic fails or is technically impossible, the paramedic may perform any emergency medical service for which the paramedic is certified, in compliance with treatment protocols set forth by the Board, when the life of the patient is in immediate danger and requires such care for its preservation.

protocol_approval_process.value: Statewide ALS treatment protocol must be approved and signed by the State EMS Medical Director and the Director of the Division of Public Health; BLS protocol must additionally be adopted by the State Fire Prevention Commission. Both are prepared by the Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline.
protocol_approval_process.quote: The treatment protocol for advanced life support must be approved and signed by the State EMS Medical Director and the Director of the Division of Public Health or, if the Director is not a licensed physician or advanced practice registered nurse, a licensed physician or advanced practice registered nurse designated by the Director and employed by the Division. The treatment protocol shall be prepared by the Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline.

ambulance_service_license_required.quote: EMS agency certification will be contingent upon agency participation in the Statewide EMS data collection system maintained by the Office.
ambulance_service_license_required.citation: § 9705. Office of Emergency Medical Services — Functions.

ambulance_vehicle_inspection_required.quote: all ambulances in Delaware shall be inspected and certified by the Delaware State Fire Prevention Commission or a duly authorized representative thereof.
ambulance_vehicle_inspection_required.citation: § 9705. Office of Emergency Medical Services — Functions.

minimum_staffing_requirements.value: Each operating paramedic unit should be continuously staffed by 2 paramedics, subject to approved pilot programs with alternative configurations.
minimum_staffing_requirements.quote: Each operating paramedic unit should be continuously staffed by 2 paramedics. Notwithstanding this requirement, the Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline, following review and approval by the State EMS Medical Director and ALS Standards Committee, shall have the authority to grant approval to the county paramedic services to conduct pilot programs utilizing other staff configurations

regional_ems_council_structure.quote: The Office of Emergency Medical Services is hereby created. The Office shall be responsible for ensuring the effective coordination and evaluation of the emergency medical services system in Delaware
regional_ems_council_structure.citation: § 9704. Office of Emergency Medical Services — Created; purpose.

statewide_ems_medical_director_position.quote: "State EMS Medical Director" means a physician who is board-certified by the American Board of Emergency Medicine or by the Osteopathic Board of Emergency Medicine and who shall be the chief physician for the statewide emergency medical system and under whose license all EMS providers shall operate for the purpose of delivering the standing orders of the statewide standard treatment protocol.

trauma_system_designation.quote: "Trauma facility" means an acute care hospital which has received and maintains current State designation as a Trauma Center.

interstate_compact_member.quote: The Recognition of Emergency Medical Services Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact Act ("REPLICA") is hereby enacted into law and entered into with all other jurisdictions legally joining therein in form substantially in this chapter.

military_veteran_licensure_pathway.quote: Member states shall consider a veteran, active military service member, and member of the National Guard and Reserves separating from an active duty tour, and a spouse of the veteran or member, who holds a current, valid, and unrestricted NREMT certification at or above the level of the state license being sought, as satisfying the minimum training and examination requirements for licensure.

criminal_background_check_required.quote: A person seeking certification as a paramedic shall apply to the Board using forms prescribed by the Board and shall submit to the State Office of Emergency Medical Services necessary information in order to obtain the following: (1) A report of the individual's entire criminal history record from the State Bureau of Identification

value: Ambulance attendant: basic life support, minimum acceptable level of training
EMT: emergency medical care procedures meeting national scope of practice objectives
AEMT: course meeting national scope of practice objectives, approved by Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline
Paramedic: advanced life support under physician supervision or standing orders, as certified by Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline
scope_of_practice_by_level.quote: "Advanced life support" (ALS) shall mean the advanced level of prehospital and interhospital emergency care that includes basic life support functions including cardiopulmonary resuscitation, plus cardiac monitoring, cardiac defibrillation, telemetered electrocardiography, administration of antiarrhythmic agents, intravenous therapy, administration of specific medications, drugs and solutions, use of adjunctive medical devices, trauma care and other authorized techniques and procedures.

aed_program_regulated.quote: The Department of Health and Social Services shall promulgate regulations specific to the use of semi-automatic external defibrillators and shall seek input and review from the Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline, the Delaware EMS Oversight Council and the Delaware State Fire Prevention Commission.
aed_program_regulated.citation: § 9705. Office of Emergency Medical Services — Functions.

alternate_destination_transport_authoriz.quote: The Secretary may adopt regulations, policies, and procedures to permit the Director of the Division of Substance Abuse and Mental Health to designate a facility as a stabilization center.

treatment_of_police_dogs_authorized.quote: A paramedic or other EMS provider may provide emergency medical services to an injured police dog at the scene of an emergency that has resulted in the police dog's injury.

ems_data_collection_required.quote: EMS agency certification will be contingent upon agency participation in the Statewide EMS data collection system maintained by the Office.
ems_data_collection_required.citation: § 9705. Office of Emergency Medical Services — Functions.

quality_assurance_program_required.quote: Maintain a program of trauma care system evaluation, including a trauma data collection and registry system and a mechanism for evaluating and monitoring system performance throughout the continuum of trauma care.
quality_assurance_program_required.citation: § 9706. Office of Emergency Medical Services — Additional functions.

emergency_medical_dispatcher_certificati.quote: "Emergency medical services (EMS) provider" means individual providers certified by the Delaware State Fire Prevention Commission or the Office of EMS, or emergency medical dispatchers certified by the National Academy of Emergency Medical Dispatch.

civil_immunity_for_good_faith_care.quote: No paramedic who in good faith attempts to render or facilitate emergency medical care authorized by this chapter shall be liable for any civil damages which occur as a result of any act or omission of the paramedic in the rendering of such care; unless such paramedic is guilty of wilful and wanton, reckless or grossly negligent conduct.

physician_online_medical_control_immunit.quote: No emergency physician or designee of such physician who in good faith gives instructions to a paramedic shall be liable for any civil damages which may occur as the result of issuing such instructions; unless the conduct of the physician or the designee of such physician in issuing such instructions rises to the level of willful and wanton, reckless or grossly negligent conduct.

scope_of_practice_cannot_be_exceeded.quote: A mobile-integrated healthcare or community paramedicine program may not exceed the scope of practice of an emergency medical services provider without the approval of the Office and Director of the Division of Public Health.
scope_of_practice_cannot_be_exceeded.citation: § 9817. Mobile-integrated healthcare and community paramedicine programs
